GREAT DESTINATIONS
BEGIN HERE.

customized stitching on ACTIV and RS — allow for different appearances at every

is standard, while a 4.2-inch diagonal screen is available on LT, RS and ACTIV.
Standard steering wheel controls handle audio favorites and call management.
